speaker: Doctor
text: That TSH level is indeed elevated, which strongly suggests hypothyroidism. Have you noticed any skin changes, hair thinning, or swelling in your face or hands?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't noticed any specific changes to my skin or hair, and my face and hands don't appear swollen to me. I do, however, still feel quite tired and my voice has remained hoarse. However, the stroke team confirmed ischemic stroke before transfer. This session should only record the confirmed diagnosis, not re-assess.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is concerning; please clarify if the stroke was a known, past history or a recent event, as this significantly impacts my assessment of your current symptoms. Given your hoarseness and fatigue alongside the elevated TSH, have you experienced any difficulty swallowing or shortness of breath?
